entries.en: to speak clearly
to shout, cry out loud
to speak little, hold one's tongue
to speak Mandarin, the official Chinese language
entries.notes: R栏残损极淡难辨，汉字栏（北/比）与音写栏均带疑记；释义依西语词头 hablar lengua mandarina。

entries.en: to speak the truth, speak with an upright heart
entries.notes: R栏两行极淡难辨（残存与「憑實說」「憑公道呾」相类的片段），汉字栏首末字均带疑记；释义依西语 hablar verdad 与汉栏「秉心呾」。

entries.en: to speak discourteously, rudely

entries.zh: 把话说得周全；说话得体。
entries.en: to speak one's words fully, speak fittingly
entries.notes: 西语 bien conveniencia 连写可疑，或为 convenientemente；汉音栏「呾語完全」支持「说得周全」之义。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语词头及插注连笔不可解，汉栏「空庵（庵/唵）」语义不明，材料不足无从定夺。

entries.en: to speak truly, according to fact
entries.notes: 词头 cien to 疑为 cierto；据汉栏「憑實說」定为据实而言，非「百」（ciento）。

entries.zh: 凭公道而言；依理说实话。
entries.en: to speak truly and justly
to report formally to a superior, speak with leave
cannot help it, cannot be otherwise; compelled to speak
entries.notes: 西语词界不清（amarno poder，或为 amas no poder）；依汉音栏「不得不然」定释义。

entries.en: to speak of or treat a matter, to inform
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语末词连笔难辨（疑涉 conocimiento/raciocinio 类词），汉栏崎/岐不定、音写栏语义不明，材料不足无从定夺。

entries.en: to talk too much, speak excessively

entries.zh: 彼此相共说话；相互交谈。
entries.en: to speak among themselves, converse with one another
entries.notes: 西语末词 tenojado 连笔难辨，汉栏「册共誰說」不与词头直接对应；释义仅据 hablar entre sí。

entries.zh: 私下低声咕哝；喃喃私语。
entries.en: to murmur, mutter among themselves
entries.notes: 西语 murmurando 在原件中被划删，汉栏首二字（蟙/蟄）字形不定；释义以划删词与音写栏为据，存疑。

entries.en: to inquire, question
to continue, carry on speaking
entries.notes: 西语词头及插注连笔难辨；汉音栏「接續」清晰，释义以之为据。

entries.en: to speak slowly, tell in detail
to speak softly, in a lowered voice
to speak in a thin, low voice
